arxiv-2304-03740.title: Three - dimensional morphology of an ultrafine Al-Si eutectic produced via laser rapid solidification Journal: Scripta Materialia
arxiv-2304-03740.creator: Xinyi Zhou, Paul Chao, Luke Sloan, Huai - Hsun Lien, Allen H. Hunter, Amit Misra, and Ashwin J. Shahani
arxiv-2304-03740.description: Abstract Al - Si alloys processed by laser rapid solidification yield eutectic microstructures with ultrafine and interconnected fibers. Such fibrous structures have long been thought to bear resemblance to those formed in impurity - doped alloys upon conventional casting. Here, we show that any similarity is purely superficial.

arxiv-2306-14984.title: Emergent Kelvin waves in chiral active matter
arxiv-2306-14984.creator: Anthony R. Poggioli, David T. Limmer
arxiv-2306-14984.description: Abstract The phenomenological equations of hydrodynamics describe emergent behavior in many body systems. Their forms and the associated phenomena are well established when the quiescent state of the system is one of thermodynamic equilibrium, yet away from equilibrium relatively little is firmly established.

arxiv-2312-02931.title: WhisBERT: Multimodal Text-Audio Language Modeling on 100M Words
arxiv-2312-02931.creator: Lukas Wolf, Greta Tuckute, Klemen Kotar, Eghbal Hosseini, Tamar I. Regev, Ethan Gotlieb Wilcox, Alex Warstadt
arxiv-2312-02931.description: Abstract Training on multiple modalities of input can augment the capabilities of a language model. Here, we ask whether such a training regime can improve the quality and efficiency of these systems as well. We focus on text–audio and introduce WhisBERT, which is inspired by the text–image approach of FLAVA ( Singh et al. 2022 ) .

arxiv-2410-03249.title: How Much Can We Forget about Data Contamination?
arxiv-2410-03249.creator: Sebastian Bordt, Suraj Srinivas, Valentyn Boreiko, Ulrike von Luxburg, [4pt] University of Tübingen, Tübingen AI Center
arxiv-2410-03249.description: Abstract The leakage of benchmark data into the training data has emerged as a significant challenge for evaluating the capabilities of large language models (LLMs). In this work, we challenge the common assumption that small-scale contamination renders benchmark evaluations invalid.

arxiv-2502-16755.title: Watch Out! E-scooter Coming Through!: Multimodal Sensing of Mixed Traffic Use and Conflicts Through Riders’ Ego-centric Views Journal: IMWUT Volume: 9 1 217 3 DOI: 10.1145/3712284 ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06
arxiv-2502-16755.creator: Hiruni Nuwanthika Kegalle, Danula Hettiachchi, Jeffrey Chan, Mark Sanderson, Flora D. Salim
arxiv-2502-16755.description: Abstract . E-scooters are becoming a popular means of urban transportation. However, this increased popularity brings challenges, such as road accidents and conflicts when sharing space with traditional transport modes. An in-depth understanding of e-scooter rider behaviour is crucial for ensuring rider safety, guiding infrastructure planning, and enforcing traffic rules.

arxiv-2512-08320.title: Developing a Strong CPS Defender: An Evolutionary Approach
arxiv-2512-08320.creator: Qingyuan Hu 2 , Christopher M. Poskitt 3 , Jun Sun 3 , Yuqi Chen ∗ 2
arxiv-2512-08320.description: Abstract Cyber-physical systems (CPSs) are used extensively in critical infrastructure, underscoring the need for anomaly detection systems that are able to catch even the most motivated attackers. Traditional anomaly detection techniques typically do ‘one-off’ training on datasets crafted by experts or generated by fuzzers, potentially limiting their ability to generalize to unseen and more subtle attack strategies.

pmc-10572168.title: A Novel Mouse Model of Intrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma Induced by Azoxymethane
pmc-10572168.creator: Yohei Shirakami, Junichi Kato, Masaya Ohnishi, Daisuke Taguchi, Toshihide Maeda, Takayasu Ideta, Masaya Kubota, Hiroyasu Sakai, Hiroyuki Tomita, Takuji Tanaka, Masahito Shimizu
pmc-10572168.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Cholangiocarcinoma is the second most common primary cancer of the liver and has a poor prognosis. Various animal models, including carcinogen-induced and genetically engineered rodent models, have been established to clarify the mechanisms underlying cholangiocarcinoma development. In the present study, we developed a novel mouse model of malignant lesions in the biliary ducts induced by the administration of the carcinogen azoxymethane to obese C57BLKS/J-db/db mice.

pmc-10707184.title: Novel Cr/Si-Slurry Diffusion Coatings for High Temperatures
pmc-10707184.creator: Michael Kerbstadt, Emma Marie Hamilton White, Mathias Christian Galetz
pmc-10707184.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Surface enrichment in Al, Si, and Cr can greatly improve high temperature oxidation resistance of many alloys. Al, Si, and Cr coatings are commonly applied via simple slurries or more complex pack cementation processes. Due to the high melting point of Cr, the deposition of Cr-based diffusion coatings by the slurry technique has proved challenging, and to date, Cr has mostly been applied by pack cementation.

pmc-10952409.title: The value of maternity care in Queensland, 2012–18, based on an analysis of administrative data: a retrospective observational study
pmc-10952409.creator: Emily J Callander, Joanne C Enticott, Bonnie Eklom, Jenny Gamble, Helena J Teede
pmc-10952409.description: ObjectiveTo quantify the value of maternity health care — the relationship of outcomes to costs — in Queensland during 2012–18.Study designRetrospective observational study; analysis of Queensland Perinatal Data Collection data linked with the Queensland Health Admitted Patient, Non‐Admitted Patient, and Emergency Data Collections, and with the Medicare Benefits Schedule (MBS) and Pharmaceutical Benefits Scheme (PBS) databases.

pmc-11406103.title: A systematic review on eHealth technology personalization approaches
pmc-11406103.creator: Iris ten Klooster, Hanneke Kip, Lisette van Gemert-Pijnen, Rik Crutzen, Saskia Kelders
pmc-11406103.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). SummaryDespite the widespread use of personalization of eHealth technologies, there is a lack of comprehensive understanding regarding its application. This systematic review aims to bridge this gap by identifying and clustering different personalization approaches based on the type of variables used for user segmentation and the adaptations to the eHealth technology and examining the role of computational methods in the literature. From the 412 included reports, we identified 13 clusters of personalization approaches, such as behavior + channeling and environment + recommendations.

pmc-12414055.title: Effective nutritional intervention improves the health-related quality of life (HRQL) of undernourished children with cancer: results of a randomized, controlled phase 3 trial
pmc-12414055.creator: Maya Prasad, Savita Goswami, Girish Chinnaswamy, Elena J Ladas, Ronald D Barr
pmc-12414055.description: PurposeThe association of nutritional intervention and health-related quality of life (HRQL) was examined in children with cancer.MethodsUndernourished children with cancer (N = 260) were randomized 1:1 to standard nutritional therapy (SNT) or SNT + Ready to Use Therapeutic Food (RUTF). HRQL was assessed using the Health Utilities Index® (HUI) at study entry and 6 weeks later.

pmc-12417627.title: Analyzing Depression in College Students Using NLP and Transformer Models: Implications for Career and Educational Counseling
pmc-12417627.creator: Qiuxia Wan, Yue Pan, Sonia Zakeri
pmc-12417627.description: PurposeDepression among college students is a growing concern that negatively affects academic performance, emotional well‐being, and career planning. Existing diagnostic methods are often slow, subjective, and inaccessible, underscoring the need for automated systems that can detect depressive symptoms through digital behavior, particularly on social media platforms.

pmc-12530605.title: The association between serum lipid levels and colorectal cancer risk: A dose-response meta-analysis of 23 studies
pmc-12530605.creator: Iman Elahi Vahed, Zahra Esmaili, Mina Pourhabib Mamaghani, Shohreh Farshid, Behina Salarian, Mobina Alamdari, Zahra Azimizadeh, Zahra Rastad, Hoda Radmard, Hossein Soltaninejad, Mohammad Rahmanian
pmc-12530605.description: BackgroundColorectal cancer (CRC) ranks as the third most prevalent cancer globally and the second leading cause of cancer-related mortality. Based on recent studies, lipid levels may have a relationship with the risk of CRC. This meta-analysis aims to better understand the association between various serum lipids and CRC risk.MethodsA comprehensive search was conducted in Web of Science, PubMed, and Scopus.

pmc-12976135.title: Ribosomal modifications are associated with mesenchymal fate selection in the neural crest lineage
pmc-12976135.creator: Irina Poverennaya, Aliia Murtazina, Lei Li, Lorena Maili, Lukas Sourada, Luis Fernando Montano-Gutierrez, Rozalina Galimullina, Tobias Steinschaden, Marketa Kaiser, Tomas Zikmund, Adna Goralija, Teng Gao, Aurore Attina, Ornella Clara, Christoph Bartenhagen, Alek G Erickson, Yaakov Gershtein, Shiyuan
pmc-12976135.description: Neural crest cells contribute to craniofacial formation by differentiating into skeletogenic mesenchyme and neuro-glial lineages. Using Smart-seq2 single-cell transcriptomics, we show that mesenchymal fate commitment correlates specifically with the expression of rRNA-modifying and ribosome assembly factors, rather than structural ribosomal proteins.

pmc-13035536.title: Levels and Determinants of Self-Reported STIs among Men in India: Evidence from National Family Health Surveys
pmc-13035536.creator: Reshmi R. S., Aparajita Chattopadhyay, Gulshan Kumar, Sumit Narayan Dwivedi
pmc-13035536.description: IntroductionSexually transmitted infections (STIs) remain a public health concern, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. Despite the availability of nationally representative data, evidence on self-reported STIs (SR-STIs) among men in India remains limited. This study examines the prevalence of SR-STI symptoms and associated factors among sexually active men in India.

pmc-13202132.title: Role of allied health professions in falls prevention for community-dwelling older adults: a scoping review
pmc-13202132.creator: Amy Lawton, Nicholas Tripodi, Rebecca Wospil, Breanna M Wright, Hylton B Menz, Suzanne Martin, Daniel R Bonanno, Corey Linton, Andisheh Bastani, Andrew Ross, Rees Thomas, Daniel Corcoran, Timothy McNamara, Danielle Baxter, Brett Vaughan, Rebecca Lane, Jack Feehan
pmc-13202132.description: ObjectiveFalls among community-dwelling older adults are prevalent and have serious individual, societal and economic consequences. Allied health professionals provide key falls prevention interventions yet their representation in current clinical practice guidelines is inconsistent. Increased recognition of allied health roles and delivering context-specific guidelines for falls care could help to address workforce gaps and optimise care approaches.

pmc-13262026.title: Probing Local Structural Variations in Metal–Organic Framework Thin Films Using Nano-FTIR
pmc-13262026.creator: Yukihiro Matsumoto, Kento Takenaka, Hiromasa Sato, Yuto Fujita, Toshiki Sugimoto, Tomoko K. Shimizu
pmc-13262026.description: Precise control over coordination structures and orientation is crucial for integrating metal–organic framework (MOF) thin films into functional devices. In this study, we combined atomic force microscopy with nano-Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy to definitively characterize local coordination bonding in a representative MOF thin film, NAFS-1, fabricated at the air/liquid interface.

pmc-13314709.title: When a Bulbar Ulcer Hides a Darker Reality: The Unusual Diagnosis of a Portal Cavernoma in a 69‐Year‐Old Adult
pmc-13314709.creator: Martin Wendlassida Nacanabo, André Arthur Taryètba Seghda, Aimé Arsène Yaméogo, Ella Hatoula Lengani, Adolphe Benjamin Zingué Ouattara, Aminata Guiarra, Yannick Laurent Tchenadoyo Bayala, Abdoul Nassir Porgo, Abdoul Aziz, Abdoul Djalilou Traoré, Anna Tall/Thiam, Georges Christian Millogo, Valentin N
pmc-13314709.description: A portal cavernoma is a network formed by localized dilation of the hepatic portal system. This study aims to describe a case of portal cavernoma in a 69‐year‐old adult presenting with gastrointestinal hemorrhage. This is a 69‐year‐old patient with no particular medical history admitted for hematemesis associated with diffuse abdominal pain.

pmc-13358235.title: Assessing WHO prioritisation criteria for children 6–59 months treated for moderate wasting in a MUAC-based protocol: a multicountry analysis in West and Central Africa
pmc-13358235.creator: Maguy Daures, Ibrahim Sana, Wah Coulibaly, Mahaman Nouhou, Susan Shepherd, Renaud Becquet, Kevin Phelan
pmc-13358235.description: BackgroundIn 2023, the WHO recommended prioritising treatment for moderately wasted children with higher risk characteristics, including mid-upper arm circumference (MUAC) 115–119 mm, weight-for-age z-score (WAZ) <–3, age <24 months or clinical and social vulnerabilities. However, applying multiple criteria is operationally challenging.

pmc-13522654.title: Addressing Existential Distress Through Compassion: Feasibility and Preliminary Effects of Compassion With You (COMwithU), a Compassion‐Based Intervention for Patients With Cancer
pmc-13522654.creator: Yeonkyu Choi, Jang Sub Kim, Hyejeong Ahn, Soowan Han, Min Cheol Seo, Jae Hyun Ryou, Da Eun Kim, Yoosuk An, Bhumsuk Keam, Tae‐Yong Kim, Eun Seoung Yu, Hye Yoon Park
pmc-13522654.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundCancer‐related distress extends beyond anxiety and depression to existential suffering, including loss of meaning, helplessness, uncertainty, and relational strain. Compassion‐based interventions in psycho‐oncology are promising, but existential outcomes such as demoralization and spiritual well‐being have rarely been examined. Compassion With You (COMwithU) is a brief, five‐session compassion‐based intervention that centers on cultivating self‐compassion, supported by the therapist's compassionate presence and by practices of extending compassion toward others.MethodsThis single‐arm feasibility study evaluated COMwithU in adult patients with cancer using a pre‐post‐1‐month follow‐up design.

pmc-13564762.title: Automated Classification of Endometrial Pathologies Using Artificial Intelligence
pmc-13564762.creator: Vasileios Bais, Panagiotis Kokkas, Charikleia Skentou, Anastasia Vatopoulou, Minas Paschopoulos, Fani Gkrozou
pmc-13564762.description: Simple SummaryHysteroscopy is a procedure providing direct visualization of the uterine cavity; however, its diagnostic accuracy depends substantially on the physician’s subjective interpretation. To address this challenge, this study aimed to develop an automated computer-based system for the objective classification of common intrauterine conditions.

uslaw-usc-t1-s1.description: United States Code, Title 1 (General Provisions); Chapter 1 (Rules Of Construction). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
